Over 50 ms is a long task

Under 50 ms

  • Normal task
  • No red mark

Over 50 ms

  • Red triangle
  • Time past 50 ms is red

A 160 ms task: the last 110 ms are red.

A button click feels slow.

The Performance panel records a trace,

so you can see the slow task.

Open the Performance panel.

Set CPU throttling.

Click Record, click the button, then click Stop.

The Main track shows the tasks.

The click starts a task on the main thread.

The main thread runs one task at a time,

so the next paint waits.

In this example the handler needs 40 milliseconds.

A 4x slowdown makes it 160, and 6x makes it 240.

Any task over 50 milliseconds is a long task.

DevTools adds a red triangle and shades

only the time past 50 milliseconds red.
